terminal_bench: The adapter uses each task.toml image and executes that task's /tests/test.sh; there is no single shared dependency profile. Every task.toml, environment/Dockerfile and tests/test.sh in the current external checkout was hashed and retained. Task scripts include uvx, direct pip, uv pip and native apt installers with different declared requirements, while Dockerfiles add further environment roots and targets. Prior OpenSSL tooling resolution does not reconstruct the other task-specific graphs or the image dependencies; no artifact unobtainability is inferred.
